title: Faculty of Commerce & Management | KPGU
content: through a balanced blend of academic rigor, experiential learning, innovation, and value-based education. Our focus is on empowering students with the knowledge, skills, and mindset required to excel in the fields of commerce, business, finance, and management. Through workshops, seminars, industrial visits, internships, skill enhancement initiatives, and mentoring support, we encourage students to explore their potential and prepare themselves for meaningful professional and personal lives.
